workflow-root.description: Relay workflow: local jobs and ordered steps.

on.description: Local manual inputs, reuse contracts, or explicitly activated automation.

strategy.description: Serial local matrix expansion, bounded to 256 variants.

url.description: Local run link resolved after job completion.

steps.description: Ordered scripts, built-in Relay actions, or frozen local actions.

entrypoints.description: Declared local job start points and their required inputs or retained artifacts.

recovery.description: Opt-in bounded automatic recovery. Per-step auto-retry can opt out.

property_descriptions.concurrency-mapping.group: Name shared by the runs or jobs that must not run at the same time. Case does not matter, and it can use expressions.
property_descriptions.concurrency-mapping.cancel-in-progress: When true, a new entry in the group also asks the one that is running to stop. Defaults to false.
property_descriptions.concurrency-mapping.queue: single, the default, keeps only the newest waiting entry. max keeps up to 100 waiting in order and cannot be used with cancel-in-progress.
property_descriptions.cron-mapping.cron: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, and day of week, such as '15 9 * * 1-5' for 9:15 on weekdays.
property_descriptions.cron-mapping.timezone: Time zone for the cron times, such as America/New_York. Defaults to UTC.
property_descriptions.entry-artifact.path: Path of the required file, relative to the project folder.
property_descriptions.entry-artifact.sha256: SHA-256 hash the file must have. The run does not start when the file differs.
property_descriptions.entrypoint.scope_path: Job this start point begins at, written root.<job ID>, such as root.check.
property_descriptions.entrypoint.inputs: Inputs that must have a value when a run starts from this job.
property_descriptions.entrypoint.artifacts: Files that must exist with an exact SHA-256 hash before a run can start from this job, keyed by name.
property_descriptions.job-defaults.run: Default shell and working directory for this job's run steps. They override the workflow defaults.
property_descriptions.job-defaults-run.shell: Shell for this job's run steps that do not choose one. It overrides the workflow default.
property_descriptions.job-defaults-run.working-directory: Folder, relative to the run's working copy, where this job's run steps start. It overrides the workflow default.
property_descriptions.job-environment-mapping.name: Name of a configured environment. Its approval rules and secrets apply before the job's steps run.
property_descriptions.job-environment-mapping.url: Link shown on the run page for this job. It is filled in after the steps finish, so it can use step outputs.
property_descriptions.job-factory.needs: Jobs that must finish before this one starts. If one fails, this job is skipped unless its if condition allows the failure.
property_descriptions.job-factory.if: Condition that decides whether the job runs. Defaults to success(), so the job is skipped when a job it needs fails.
property_descriptions.job-factory.strategy: Runs the job once per combination of matrix values, one variant after another. fail-fast decides whether a failure skips the rest.
property_descriptions.job-factory.name: Name shown for the job on the canvas and in runs. It can use expressions; the job ID stays the same.
property_descriptions.job-factory.timeout-minutes: Longest the job may run, up to 360 minutes, which is also the default. When time runs out, the running step fails.
property_descriptions.job-factory.continue-on-error: When true, jobs that need this one treat its failure as success. Its failed changes still do not carry on to later jobs.
property_descriptions.job-factory.env: Environment variables for every step in this job. They override workflow env values with the same name.
property_descriptions.job-factory.environment: Configured environment whose approval rules, variables, and secrets apply to this job: a name, or a mapping with name and url.
property_descriptions.job-factory.concurrency: Keeps this job from running at the same time as others in its group, across runs: a group name, or a mapping with group, cancel-in-progress, and queue.
property_descriptions.job-factory.outputs: Values this job passes to jobs that need it, usually from its steps, such as ${{ steps.check.outputs.result }}.
property_descriptions.job-factory.defaults: Default shell and working directory for this job's run steps.
property_descriptions.job-factory.steps: Ordered steps. They share one working copy; changed files are committed once when the job succeeds.
property_descriptions.job-factory.cache-mode: How cache actions in this job may use the project cache: write, read, write-only, or none. Defaults to the workflow's cache-mode.
property_descriptions.matrix.include: Extra combinations to run, or extra values to add to combinations that match.
property_descriptions.matrix.exclude: Combinations to leave out of the matrix.
property_descriptions.on-mapping.workflow_dispatch: Lets you start the workflow from Relay. Declare inputs to have the Run dialog ask for values first.
property_descriptions.on-mapping.workflow_call: Lets another workflow run this one as a job with uses: ./.relay/workflows/<file>. Declares the inputs, secrets, and outputs they exchange.
property_descriptions.on-mapping.schedule: Starts runs at times given as five-field cron lines, checked once a minute while Relay is running. Works only after you activate it.
property_descriptions.on-mapping.push: Starts a run when a branch or tag in this repository changes on this computer, filtered by name and changed paths. Works only after you activate it.
property_descriptions.on-mapping.repository_dispatch: Starts a run when a program on this computer posts an event to Relay's local API, optionally filtered by types. Works only after you activate it.
property_descriptions.on-mapping.workflow_run: Starts a run when a run of another workflow in this project finishes, filtered by workflow, branch, and result. Works only after you activate it.
property_descriptions.push-mapping.branches: Branch name patterns that start a run when the branch changes. With only tags set, branch changes start nothing. Cannot be used with branches-ignore.
property_descriptions.push-mapping.branches-ignore: Branch name patterns whose changes never start a run. Cannot be used with branches.
property_descriptions.push-mapping.tags: Tag name patterns that start a run when the tag changes. With only branches set, tag changes start nothing. Cannot be used with tags-ignore.
property_descriptions.push-mapping.tags-ignore: Tag name patterns whose changes never start a run. Cannot be used with tags.
property_descriptions.push-mapping.paths: File path patterns. A change starts a run only when at least one changed file matches. Cannot be used with paths-ignore.
property_descriptions.push-mapping.paths-ignore: File path patterns. A change is skipped when every changed file matches. Cannot be used with paths.
property_descriptions.recovery.enabled: When true, Relay retries an agent step that fails a report, protocol, or time-limit check, with a separate repair instruction. Defaults to false.
property_descriptions.recovery.max_retries: Most automatic retries one agent step may use over its lifetime: 1 or 2. Defaults to 2.
property_descriptions.regular-step.name: Name shown for the step in the job and in run logs. It can use expressions.
property_descriptions.regular-step.id: Name that later steps use to read this step's results, as in ${{ steps.<id>.outputs.<name> }}. It must be unique in the job.
property_descriptions.regular-step.if: Condition that decides whether the step runs. Defaults to success(), so the step is skipped after an earlier step fails.
property_descriptions.regular-step.continue-on-error: When true, later steps run as if this step succeeded. steps.<id>.outcome still records the failure.
property_descriptions.regular-step.timeout-minutes: Longest this step may run, in minutes. It cannot extend the job's time limit; when time runs out, the step fails.
property_descriptions.regular-step.uses: Action to run: a built-in relay/…@v1 action or a local action under ./.relay/actions/.
property_descriptions.regular-step.with: Inputs for the action. Every value is text; list inputs take a JSON array or one value per line.
property_descriptions.regular-step.env: Environment variables for this step only. They override job and workflow env values with the same name.
property_descriptions.repository-dispatch-mapping.types: Event types that start a run, compared with the posted event_type. Without types, every posted event starts a run.
property_descriptions.run-step.name: Name shown for the step in the job and in run logs. It can use expressions.
property_descriptions.run-step.id: Name that later steps use to read this step's results, as in ${{ steps.<id>.outputs.<name> }}. It must be unique in the job.
property_descriptions.run-step.if: Condition that decides whether the step runs. Defaults to success(), so the step is skipped after an earlier step fails.
property_descriptions.run-step.timeout-minutes: Longest this step may run, in minutes. It cannot extend the job's time limit; when time runs out, the step fails.
property_descriptions.run-step.run: Script to run in the job's working copy. Relay writes it to a private file and starts the selected shell; a non-zero exit fails the step.
property_descriptions.run-step.continue-on-error: When true, later steps run as if this step succeeded. steps.<id>.outcome still records the failure.
property_descriptions.run-step.env: Environment variables for this step only. They override job and workflow env values with the same name.
property_descriptions.run-step.working-directory: Folder, relative to the run's working copy, where the script starts. It must stay inside the working copy.
property_descriptions.run-step.shell: Program that runs the script: bash, sh, pwsh, powershell, cmd, python, or a command containing {0} for the script path. Defaults to the host's shell.
property_descriptions.strategy.fail-fast: When true, the default, a failed variant skips the variants that have not started. Set false to run them all.
property_descriptions.strategy.matrix: Values to combine, one list per name, plus include and exclude. Each combination runs as its own variant, up to 256 in all.
property_descriptions.workflow-call-input-definition.descripti: Explains the input to people writing a calling job. It does not affect the run.
property_descriptions.workflow-call-input-definition.type: Kind of value the calling job passes: string, boolean, or number.
property_descriptions.workflow-call-input-definition.required: When true, a calling job must pass this input. Defaults to false.
property_descriptions.workflow-call-input-definition.default: Value used when the calling job does not pass this input. It must fit the input's type.
property_descriptions.workflow-call-mapping.inputs: Values a calling job passes with with:, keyed by name. Each declares a type of string, boolean, or number.
property_descriptions.workflow-call-mapping.secrets: Secret names a calling job may pass with secrets:. Mark one required to make callers pass it.
property_descriptions.workflow-call-mapping.outputs: Values this workflow returns to the calling job, each computed from its jobs' outputs.
property_descriptions.workflow-call-output-definition.descript: Explains the output to people using this workflow. It does not affect the run.
property_descriptions.workflow-call-output-definition.value: Expression that computes the output from this workflow's jobs, such as ${{ jobs.build.outputs.path }}.
Explains what the secret is for. It does not affect the run.
When true, a calling job must pass this secret. Defaults to false.
property_descriptions.workflow-defaults.run: Default shell and working directory for run steps in this workflow.
property_descriptions.workflow-defaults-run.shell: Shell for run steps that do not choose one: bash, sh, pwsh, powershell, cmd, python, or a command containing {0}. Job defaults override it.
property_descriptions.workflow-defaults-run.working-directory: Folder, relative to the run's working copy, where run steps start. It must stay inside the working copy. Job and step values override it.
property_descriptions.workflow-dispatch-input.description: Help text shown with this input in the Run dialog.
property_descriptions.workflow-dispatch-input.type: Kind of value: string (the default), boolean, number, choice with options, or environment, which offers your configured environments.
property_descriptions.workflow-dispatch-input.required: When true, a run cannot start without a value. Defaults to false.
property_descriptions.workflow-dispatch-input.default: Value used when none is entered. It must fit the input's type.
property_descriptions.workflow-dispatch-input.options: Choices for a choice input, as a YAML list. A default must be one of them.
property_descriptions.workflow-dispatch-mapping.inputs: Values the Run dialog asks for before a run starts, keyed by name. Steps read them as ${{ inputs.<name> }}.
property_descriptions.workflow-job.name: Name shown for the job on the canvas and in runs. It can use expressions; the job ID stays the same.
property_descriptions.workflow-job.uses: Workflow file to run as this job, such as ./.relay/workflows/check.yaml. That workflow must declare on: workflow_call.
property_descriptions.workflow-job.with: Inputs for the called workflow, matching the inputs under its on.workflow_call.
property_descriptions.workflow-job.secrets: Secrets for the called workflow, by name, or inherit to pass this workflow's secrets. Without it, none are passed.
property_descriptions.workflow-job.needs: Jobs that must finish before this one starts. If one fails, this job is skipped unless its if condition allows the failure.
property_descriptions.workflow-job.if: Condition that decides whether the job runs. Defaults to success(), so the job is skipped when a job it needs fails.
property_descriptions.workflow-job.concurrency: Keeps this job from running at the same time as others in its group, across runs: a group name, or a mapping with group, cancel-in-progress, and queue.
property_descriptions.workflow-job.strategy: Runs the called workflow once per combination of matrix values, one after another.
property_descriptions.workflow-job.cache-mode: Limits how the called workflow may use the project cache: write (the default), read, write-only, or none. It cannot regain access you remove.
property_descriptions.workflow-root.on: Events that can start this workflow. workflow_dispatch lets you start it from Relay; schedule, push, and the other events start runs only after you activate them.
property_descriptions.workflow-root.name: Name shown in the workflow list and on each run. Defaults to the file's path.
property_descriptions.workflow-root.description: Longer explanation of what this workflow does, for people reading or choosing it. It does not change how the workflow runs.
property_descriptions.workflow-root.run-name: Title given to each run. It can use expressions such as ${{ inputs.task }} and is cut to 1,000 characters. Defaults to the workflow name.
property_descriptions.workflow-root.defaults: Default shell and working directory for every run step in the workflow. Job defaults and the step's own values override them.
property_descriptions.workflow-root.env: Environment variables given to every step of every job. Job and step env values with the same name override them.
property_descriptions.workflow-root.concurrency: Keeps runs that share a group from running at the same time: a group name, or a mapping with group, cancel-in-progress, and queue. Later runs wait their turn.
property_descriptions.workflow-root.jobs: The work to do, as jobs keyed by job ID. Jobs run one at a time on this computer, ordered by needs and then by their place in the file.
property_descriptions.workflow-root.cache-mode: How cache actions may use the project cache: write (read and write, the default), read, write-only, or none.
property_descriptions.workflow-root.entrypoints: Jobs a run may start from, each with the inputs and files it needs. Run from here in the editor adds an entry.
property_descriptions.workflow-root.recovery: Automatic retries for agent steps that fail a report, protocol, or time-limit check. Off unless enabled; max_retries caps the retries per step.
property_descriptions.workflow-run-mapping.workflows: Names or file keys of the workflows whose finished runs start this one. Without it, any other workflow in the project counts.
property_descriptions.workflow-run-mapping.branches: Branch name patterns. Only a finished run that started on a matching branch starts this workflow.
property_descriptions.workflow-run-mapping.branches-ignore: Branch name patterns. A finished run that started on a matching branch does not start this workflow.
property_descriptions.workflow-run-mapping.conclusions: Results that start this workflow: success, failure, or cancelled. Without it, any finished run counts.
